posts.text: ChatGPT becomes a full Chrome browser assistant that reads and acts on your open tabs. OpenAI's updated Chrome extension lets ChatGPT access open browser tabs, sum up content, and use "Computer Use" in Work mode to fill out forms or compare products across several tabs. It is open to all ChatGPT plans. The article ChatGPT becomes a full Chrome browser assistant that reads and acts on your open tabs appeared first on The Decoder .
